Act5-1#1.zh: 刚才是你说要把俺打得『一佛出世，二佛升天』？有本事就来啊？哇哈哈！
Act5-1#1.t: Was it you who said you'd beat me until 'one Buddha is born and a second ascends'? Come on then, if you can! Wahaha!

Act5-1#2.zh: (可恶...待会儿等我兄弟来救时，看我怎么报仇...)
Act5-1#2.t: (Damn it... just wait till my brother comes to rescue me. Then I'll get my revenge...)

Act5-1#3.zh: 太公，洒家没有骗你吧！这个强盗头子不会再烦你了；到时候把这一伙人送至官府还可以领到一大笔赏金。这都是我佛慈悲；善哉善哉...哦，没酒了？太公，再拿酒来！
Act5-1#3.t: Squire, I didn't lie to you, did I? This bandit chief won't bother you again. Hand this lot over to the magistrate and you'll even get a fat reward. All thanks to the Buddha's mercy, amitabha... Oh, out of wine? Squire, more wine!

Act5-1#5.zh: 贤弟，何不引见一下这位师兄？
Act5-1#5.t: Brother, won't you introduce this reverend brother?

Act5-1#6.zh: 他原本是经略府提辖，姓鲁名达；过去曾经有一面之缘，他曾经在史家村借住过一阵子。不过为什么剃了一个大光头，我就不清楚了。
Act5-1#6.t: He was a major in the Pacification Commissioner's office, Lu Da by name. We met once before; he stayed at Shi Family Village for a while. Why he's shaved his head, though, I've no idea.

Act5-1#7.zh: 洒家三拳打死一名叫『镇关西』的郑姓屠夫，被官府通缉；想想干脆上五台山当和尚避避风头...
Act5-1#7.t: I killed a butcher named Zheng, the one called 'Lord of the West', with three punches, and the law was after me. So I figured I'd go be a monk on Mount Wutai until things cooled down...

Act5-1#9.zh: 结果在五台山上喝酒吃狗肉、打坏了看山门的金刚力士、打伤了数十个和尚...被赶下山了。
Act5-1#9.t: Then on Mount Wutai I drank wine, ate dog meat, smashed the guardian statues at the gate and beat up dozens of monks... so they threw me out.

Act5-1#10.zh: 临走时，智真长老送了洒家四句偈子：『遇林而起，遇山而富，遇水而兴，遇江而止。』洒家到如今也参不透。
Act5-1#10.t: When I left, Abbot Zhizhen gave me a four-line verse: 'Rise at the forest, prosper at the mountain, flourish at the water, stop at the river.' I still can't make sense of it.

Act5-1#12.zh: 啊？原来你不是五台山上的高僧？！
Act5-1#12.t: What? So you're not a holy monk from Mount Wutai?!

Act5-1#13.zh: 洒家又没说自己是高僧；俺从五台山下来也是事实...啊，没肉了，再拿五斤肉来。
Act5-1#13.t: I never said I was a holy monk. I did come down from Mount Wutai, that's true... Ah, out of meat. Five more catties!

Act5-1#14.zh: 阿弥陀佛...我怎么留了一个花和尚下来...
Act5-1#14.t: Amitabha... what kind of tattooed monk have I taken in...

Act5-1#15.zh: 太公，桃花山大头目拜见。
Act5-1#15.t: Squire, the chief of Peach Blossom Mountain is here to see you.

Act5-1#17.zh: 无妨。叫他进来，他敢作怪就一同捉起来！
Act5-1#17.t: No matter. Send him in. If he tries anything, we'll grab him too!

Act5-1#18.zh: 手下留情！吾弟管教不周，冒犯尊颜；希望壮士能够网开一面，放吾弟一条生路。在下一定备齐金银珠宝作为谢礼...
Act5-1#18.t: Have mercy! My brother was poorly taught and offended you. I hope you heroes will spare his life. I'll prepare gold, silver and jewels as thanks...

Act5-1#20.zh: 史进？你不是史进吗？好久不见！
Act5-1#20.t: Shi Jin? Aren't you Shi Jin? Long time no see!

Act5-1#23.zh: 这位是『打虎将』李忠，我的第七任师父。
Act5-1#23.t: This is 'Tiger Fighter' Li Zhong, my seventh teacher.

Act5-1#25.t: Master, what are you doing here?

Act5-1#26.zh: 刚才被你们打的那名大汉叫做『小霸王』周通；原本就在桃花山上当大王。前些日子抢劫路人时抢到你师父，被我打败；结果他把山寨中第一把交椅给我坐了，自己情愿坐第二把交椅。
Act5-1#26.t: The big fellow you beat just now is the 'Little King' Zhou Tong. He was already king of Peach Blossom Mountain. Some days ago he robbed your master on the road, and I beat him. So he gave me the first seat in the stronghold and gladly took the second.

Act5-1#27.zh: ……咦，这位师父，你的声音好厮熟。莫不是渭州的鲁提辖？
Act5-1#27.t: ...Hm, reverend, your voice sounds very familiar. Could you be Major Lu of Weizhou?

Act5-1#28.zh: 洒家不是别人，老种经略相公帐前提辖鲁达的便是。如今出了家做和尚，唤做鲁智深。李忠，你还在街上使枪棒卖膏药么？
Act5-1#28.t: None other! Lu Da, major under old Commissioner Zhong. Now I've left home to be a monk, called Lu Zhishen. Li Zhong, are you still selling plasters with your spear show in the street?

Act5-1#29.zh: 哥哥别来无恙！小弟如今在桃花山落草，惭愧，惭愧。
Act5-1#29.t: Good to see you well, brother! I've become an outlaw on Peach Blossom Mountain now. How shameful, how shameful.

Act5-1#30.zh: 哈哈，原来都是故人！来来，坐下喝酒... 啊，椅子不够了；太公，拿椅子来！
Act5-1#30.t: Haha, old friends all round! Come, sit, drink... Ah, not enough chairs. Squire, bring chairs!

Act5-1#31.zh: (完蛋了，原来这群贼党是一伙的！连那个花和尚都跟他们称兄道弟...)
Act5-1#31.t: (It's over. These bandits are all one gang! Even that tattooed monk calls them brothers...)

Act5-1#32.zh: 太公别紧张。大家都先坐下。
Act5-1#32.t: Don't worry, squire. Everyone, sit down first.

Act5-1#33.zh: 李师父也在这里当个见证；刘太公这门亲事就不要再提了。他只有这个女儿，周兄弟这样霸王硬上弓也没道理；不如就此作罢。从此两家和平，好吗？
Act5-1#33.t: Master Li is here as a witness too. Let's drop this marriage to Squire Liu's daughter. She's his only child, and Brother Zhou forcing it on her isn't right. Let's call it off and let both houses live in peace. All right?

Act5-1#35.zh: 兄弟，%X兄都已经这么说了，你就看你老哥哥份上答应了吧。
Act5-1#35.t: Brother, %X has said his piece. For your old brother's sake, agree.

Act5-1#37.zh: 哇哈哈！太好了！大家达成共识又不伤和气，值得庆祝！太公，还有什么吃的喝的全部拿上来！
Act5-1#37.t: Wahaha! Excellent! Everyone agrees and nobody's sore. That calls for a celebration! Squire, bring out everything there is to eat and drink!

Act5-1#38.zh: 鲁兄，接下来你有什么打算吗？
Act5-1#38.t: Brother Lu, what are your plans now?

Act5-1#39.zh: 五台山是回不去；嗯...跟着你们似乎会遇上不少有趣的事。好！我就跟你们一起走吧！就这么决定了！
Act5-1#39.t: I can't go back to Mount Wutai. Hmm... following you lot, I'll probably run into plenty of fun. Right! I'll come along with you! It's decided!

Act5-1#40.zh: 喂喂，不要这样擅自决定好不好...(苦笑)
Act5-1#40.t: Hey, hey, don't just decide that on your own... (wry smile)

Act5-1#41.zh: 他以前就是这样的性格...

Act5-1#42.zh: 第二天，李忠与周通带着喽罗们回到桃花山上，继续过著打家劫舍的日子；%N一行人也继续踏上旅程，往延安府前进。
Act5-1#42.t: The next day, Li Zhong and Zhou Tong took their men back to Peach Blossom Mountain to carry on raiding. %N and the others continued their journey toward Yan'an.

Act5-1#43.zh: 经过大家的努力，桃花村又恢复了以往的平静。
Act5-1#43.t: Thanks to everyone's efforts, Peach Blossom Village was peaceful once more.
